Subject: APAC/EU SI onboarding: data residency constraints & integration checklist

Hi Emma + Alvin —

Thanks again for agreeing to kick off the regional SI onboarding discussion. We want to make this as prescriptive as possible so KPMG (EU) and YTL (APAC) can run faster with customers that have strict data residency and audit requirements.

Attached are two starter artifacts: 1) SI_onboarding_template_v1.docx (a suggested workshop agenda + responsibilities) and 2) data-residency-matrix_2026-03.xlsx (matrix of deployment options and what evidence each supports). Please take a look.

High-level ask from our side:
- Validate the matrix fields that are missing for APAC countries you cover (data residency nuances differ by market)
- Confirm whether your customers prefer a customer-managed KMS or vendor KMS for on-prem/VPC options
- Identify at least one pilot customer per region who would be comfortable with a short technical workshop (2–3 hours) in the next 3 weeks

Suggested agenda for the kickoff workshop (we can refine):
- 10m intros, 20m deployment options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), 35m hands-on integration patterns (private control plane, KMS, audit logs), 25m compliance evidence mapping (SOC2 / ISO / local regs), 10m next steps

Proposed times (I listed slots in both BST and SGT below to make scheduling easier):
- Tue 10 Mar 09:00 BST / 17:00 SGT
- Wed 11 Mar 14:00 BST / 22:00 SGT (later for APAC)
- Fri 13 Mar 08:00 BST / 16:00 SGT

Vanessa, can you confirm which of those slots you can own from product/ops? Avery — would you be able to draft a short runbook that maps Redwood Private configuration → audit artifacts customers will need?

Emma/Alvin — flags or missing items? If this looks good I can send calendar invites and a single consolidated agenda.

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez

Thanks Sergio — this is a helpful start.

A few quick points from KPMG UK perspective:
- For a number of our regulated clients in financial services, EU-only tenancy is required (no cross-region backups). Please add a column in the matrix for backup/replication residency guarantees and retention controls.
- Our security team will want to see evidence of audit logs (immutable S3-like storage or equivalent) and access to raw audit streams for internal SI tooling. What options do you expose for log export (syslog, cloud storage sink, SIEM connectors)?
- KMS: most enterprise customers will require a customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key). We also need details on HSM-backed key wrapping for high-sensitivity workloads.

We can identify two pilot customers: one mid-sized UK bank comfortable with a Dedicated deployment, and a public-sector agency open to a Private VPC evaluation (air-gapped conversation later).

I can attend Tue 10 Mar 09:00 BST. If you send the agenda I will circulate to our technical lead.

Emma Smith
Partner, Cloud & Data Services — KPMG UK

Appreciate the quick read, Emma. Answering the checklist items from a product/ops angle: 

- Backups/Replication: Redwood Dedicated supports region-scoped storage, and Private deployments can be configured to keep backups in-customer-region only. I updated the matrix with a "backup residency" column (see attached matrix). We do not replicate across regions by default for Private.
- Audit logs: We provide realtime audit streams via secure HTTPS sink and an S3-compatible export. For Dedicated we can enable an append-only export to customer storage; for Private we can set up an on-prem collector. We will add sample syslog and S3 connector configs to the onboarding template.
- KMS/HSM: Private supports BYOK via standard KMS integrations and HSM-backed keywrap for high-sensitivity workloads; we've documented a recommended HSM cert chain in the runbook draft.

Avery — can you produce a 1-page runbook section called "Evidence & Artifacts" that maps each compliance ask (SOC2 control ID, log CSV, retention policy) to the exact file/location generated by Redwood? I can take the lead on the Hands-on integration slide deck for the workshop.

I can attend Tue 10 Mar 09:00 BST as well.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Product Ops | Redwood Inference\vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
